tariff.title: Interactive Brokers - Commissions
tariff.notes: Commissions: Stocks, ETFs, Warrants and Structured Products; Spot Currencies; Other Fees; Required Minimums (interactivebrokers.com, ללא תאריך; אותן טבלאות ב-interactivebrokers.ie). Binding through the client agreement: Interactive Brokers LLC form 3203 (10 January 2025, library b866cea6e6d76d50, same bytes on 2026-11-04), s.33A 'Client shall pay to IBKR commissions, fees and interest at the rates and terms specified on the IBKR website', changes 'effective immediately ... upon posting' (s.33B); Interactive Brokers Ireland form 4750: 'Costs and Charges are as specified on the Pricing section'. The pages say 'IBKR may change these rates at any time in its sole discretion'. Re-read 2026-11-04: every figure in the lines unchanged; the FINRA trading activity fee is 'USD 0.00' with a fee holiday from 1 October to 31 December 2026. התעריף ללקוח ישיר; לקוח שהופנה דרך ברוקר מציג משלם את תעריף הברוקר המציג.

The other-fees page lists the third-party custody fees it passes through, by market: Brazil, Czech Republic, Germany, Hungary, Israel and others; none for the US, the UK or Ireland, where the S&P 500 funds this line prices are listed. rate.notes: 'Tel Aviv Exchange', 'Custody Fee', 'ILS denominated stocks', '0.08 %', note 1: 'Annual rate applied to value of portfolio (applicable securities) computed and charged on a daily basis in the trading denomination of the securities.' A third-party fee passed through, under the footer's 'Custody fees may be charged by third parties'. source.title: Commissions Spot Currencies, Tiered, Monthly Trade Value ≤ 1,000,000,000: 0.20 basis point * Trade Value

rate.notes: Printed '0.20 basis point * Trade Value' for monthly trade value up to USD 1,000,000,000 (then 0.15, 0.10, 0.08 basis point), with '1 basis point=0.0001': 0.00002 of the value, recorded as 0.002% (pct_of_trade, as at Interactive Israel). The USD 2.00 minimum is in min. 'Commissions for currency trades are calculated off the trade value and then converted and charged to the base currency of the account.' 'All exchange and regulatory fees included.' On the rate: 'IBKR passes through the prices that it receives and charges a separate low commission. We do this in the interest of providing a transparent pricing structure instead of marking up our quotes' and, in the page's heading, 'Transparent low commissions with no mark-ups on quotes' (both re-read on the live page 2026-11-06); the market's own bid and ask remain. No `spread` is recorded: the page prints no ceiling on a spread of the kind the Israeli price lists print ('עד 0.7% משער ההמרה'), it says the quotes are passed on unmarked, so no spread beyond the market's is priced (F-13). Until 2026-11-04 this rate was left empty for want of a basis-point unit.

source.title: Commissions Spot Currencies, Minimum per order, Tier I
Commissions Spot Currencies, note on the auto currency conversion service
source.quote: typically add or subtract (at its discretion) 0.03% to the exchange rate

rate.notes: 'For currency trades executed under the auto currency conversion service, IB will typically add or subtract (at its discretion) 0.03% to the exchange rate that would otherwise apply. Please note that IB does not separately charge a commission on these auto-conversion trades.' A markup on the rate, not a commission. Not limited by the documents (D56): the price list says 'typically' and 'at its discretion', and the client agreement (form 3203, s.32C) says the automatic conversion rate 'may be adjusted from the rate that otherwise would apply'. 0.03% is the figure printed, not a ceiling. A client who converts by a spot order instead pays the spot line (0.002%, minimum USD 2), with no markup on the quote.
